acceptance_criteria.text: When given a single成交價 below 10,000,000, the Skill outputs service fee = 成交價 × 1%, then floors to the nearest 1,000.
When given a single成交價 exactly 10,000,000, the Skill uses the 1.5% tier and floors the result to the nearest 1,000.
When given a single成交價 between 10,000,000 and 29,999,999, the Skill uses the 1.5% tier and floors the result to the nearest 1,000.
When given a single成交價 exactly 30,000,000, the Skill uses the 2% tier and floors the result to the nearest 1,000.
When given a single成交價 above 30,000,000, the Skill uses the 2% tier and floors the result to the nearest 1,000.
The Skill does not apply progressive marginal rates; it applies only one tier to the full成交價.
The output is the final fee amount only, not a step-by-step calculation.

evaluation.summary: 已驗證低於一千萬、恰好一千萬、一千萬至兩千九百九十九萬九千九百九十九區間，以及高於三千萬時的結果與單一級距計算一致，且只輸出最終金額。由於本次未測試恰好 30,000,000 元，該門檻行為無法判定。

criterion_results.text: When given a single成交價 exactly 10,000,000, the Skill uses the 1.5% tier and floors the result to the nearest 1,000.
criterion_results.reason: 對恰好 10,000,000 元的輸出為 150,000 元，符合 1.5% 級距並捨去至千元。

criterion_results.text: When given a single成交價 between 10,000,000 and 29,999,999, the Skill uses the 1.5% tier and floors the result to the nearest 1,000.
criterion_results.reason: 對 20,000,000 元的輸出為 300,000 元，符合 1.5% 套用全額並捨去至千元。

criterion_results.text: When given a single成交價 exactly 30,000,000, the Skill uses the 2% tier and floors the result to the nearest 1,000.
criterion_results.reason: 本次輸入未包含恰好 30,000,000 元的成交價；30,000,001 元的結果不足以直接驗證恰好等於該門檻時的行為。

criterion_results.text: When given a single成交價 above 30,000,000, the Skill uses the 2% tier and floors the result to the nearest 1,000.
The Skill does not apply progressive marginal rates; it applies only one tier to the full成交價.
criterion_results.reason: 20,000,000 元輸出 300,000 元、30,000,001 元輸出 600,000 元，與各自單一級距套用於全額的結果一致，而非累進邊際費率。

criterion_results.text: The output is the final fee amount only, not a step-by-step calculation.
criterion_results.reason: 最終輸出僅列出四筆費用金額，未包含計算步驟。
